title: Siri AI adds personal context, onscreen awareness and a dedicated app
friendlyTitle: Siri can now understand more about you and your screen
summary: Apple’s rebuilt Siri can hold longer conversations, use information on screen, search personal messages, email and photos, and answer broader web questions. It also adds a dedicated app and uses Apple’s privacy-focused architecture across supported devices.
friendlySummary: The new Siri can talk more naturally, use information from your Apple apps and understand what is on your screen.
whyItMatters: A system assistant that can understand personal context may reduce everyday friction in finding information and acting across apps. Users should still review which data and actions they allow an assistant to access.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may make everyday phone tasks quicker, but you should check what personal information Siri can use.
